point_side.chain: 0 < j < C < im A2 < ker A2 < C_perp < j_perp < M

irreducibility_scan.method: one cyclic-span test per group orbit, covering every nonzero vector

point_side.reading: one filtration generates the binary facts: the sentinel code C is the second layer (1+14), the SO(10) shadow H10 = C_perp/C is the middle sandwich (1,8,1) with its fixed vector f = [im A2], and the E8 shadow is the central 8-layer ker A2/im A2

line_side.reading: the line module rearranges: rank A_L = 10 = q^2+1, the route hull has dimension 9, im A_L lies in route-perp but not in the route code, and the point-side chain does not transfer unchanged to line coordinates
